title: Observability & Monitoring
intro: Observability interview questions cover the three pillars (metrics, logs, traces) plus the engineering culture around them — Micrometer + Prometheus + Grafana, structured logging (JSON, MDC, correlation IDs), distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry, Zipkin, Jaeger), SLI/SLO/SLA definitions, error budgets, the four golden signals, alerting design (avoiding alert fatigue), and the pragmatic question every senior interview asks: "what would you instrument first in a brand-new service?". For incident response and on-call see the SRE page.
